entry.title: Neon White v0.2.0
entry.content:
*Looking for the Neon White mod? Find it [here!](https://github.com/stxticOVFL/NWArchipelagoMod/releases/latest)* *Compatible with v0.2.x of the NWArchipelago mod.*
- ### **Card abilities can now be split across missions!** - Abilities can be set to either: - unlock **per in-game mission** (e.g. Rebirth - Elevate (Fire) to get it for every level that is in Rebirth in the base game), which is **currently the new default**, - unlock per **generated mission** (e.g. Mission 1 - Elevate (Fire) to get it for every level in your *own* Mission 1), - or keep them **global** (e.g. one Elevate (Fire) for the whole game). - You can also set certain cards to be **forced to be global** on the mission settings (e.g. it defaults to Katana and the Book of Life being 1 item each for the whole game.) - Additionally, some cards are now marked as *Useful* instead of *Progression* when they aren't logically relevant, and only cards that appear in those missions will appear in the item pool at all. - Level Randomization has been tweaked to make for better progression! - Levels now properly take into account all the items you would have to clear every check in that level, and influences other levels that are similar to it to be closer to it. - The **Level Selection Variance** setting acts very similar still, with 0% meaning it will guarantee levels in a linear order, and 100% being very random. The **default for this setting was changed** to *30%* down from *50%*. - The **Starting Level Count** setting has been changed to go off of total check counts for your starting items. - Previously, it only added starting levels that were guaranteed to be completable to your max medal, and would not select any levels that don't have gifts. - This change was made to prevent restrictive starts even harder, and should make the start of the world more open. Thus, the **default for this setting was changed** to *3* down from *5*. Most settings couldn't reach 5 starting levels that fit in the criteria anyway. - New filler items have been introduced to help any potential filler feel less repetitive. - Added items: Garbage, Book of Death Page, Cloud 9 Minigolf Ball, Neon Mask, Secret of Heaven. - All of these are referenced in voiced dialogue! - (Hopefully with all of these changes, you won't be seeing that much of these anyway!)
## APWorld-Only Changes - **Universal Tracker is now** (actually) **fully supported!** (and I actually tested it this time) - This includes **yaml-less, glitched logic, custom location sorting that fits your mission order, and shiny new `/explain` for relevant checks!** - There are now **option groups** that helps keep the options in the launcher's options creator nice and categorized/sorted! - An absurd amount of internal restructuring that makes for both less fill errors and faster fill! - Neon Ranks outside of the % required are classified as Useful for item filling. They're turned back to Progression in post fill (keeps UT in check and makes spoiler log generate faster). - A custom rule builder rule class has been made to check rules faster than before, including its own caching system which especially helps for worlds with multiple Neon Whites. - There is now a custom fill hook that places items inside the progression item pool in a way that speeds up gen and helps the generator get less stuck. - Fuzzer meta files have been added to the repo for checking progress against the fuzzer tool: - [`fuzzer_default`](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/fuzzer_default.yaml) checks against most of the default settings. (**100%!**) - [`fuzzer_player`](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/fuzzer_player.yaml) checks settings that are within reasonable ranges and probabilities for most people who play this APWorld. (**~100%!**) - [`fuzzer_all`](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/fuzzer_all.yaml) just ensures the goal condition is set to `3bosses` to help limit the amount of ignored results. (roughly **98%** success rate!) - Various other changes were made to ensure we pass all unit tests! - (except for the memory leak test: there are no problems when actually generating (including no-output), but specifically the test doesn't appear to like it.)
### **Check the [game info](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/docs/en_Neon%20White.md) and [complete setup guide!](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/docs/setup_en.md)**

entry.title: Kirby & The Amazing Mirror v0.5.0
entry.content:
## v0.5.0
The official v0.5.0 release of Kirby & The Amazing Mirror for Archipelago, built from main commit `744b1a5708ecaafd80313b7836a9197a25f5db0e`.
### Highlights - Eight **Area Keys** for Areas 2–9 gate cross-area travel. Locked mirrors show boards, associated Warp Stars stay hidden, and receiving a key updates eligible nearby routes while preserving other requirements. The default-on Area Keys option can be disabled to replace all eight keys with filler. - Fifteen **Hub Connections** unlock hub shortcuts independently of their physical Big Switch checks, while alternate overland routes remain available. - Eight new Kirby palettes: Rainbow, Candy Corn, Negative, Pineapple, Cotton Candy, Royal, Pumpkin and Mint Chip. - **Hub Teleport Trap**, the `/goal` command, and **Defeat a Number of Area Bosses** (1–8 distinct area bosses, default 3). New boss-count seeds require the updated KirbyAM client. - Fixes for lower-cave chest logic, Room Sanity reachability, starting-item delivery, DeathLink, reconnects, enemy ability randomization, Invincibility Candy and scaled enemy health.
### Why you may start with the Moonlight Mansion Area Key With Area Keys enabled, generation counts the checks your slot can actually reach with its starting inventory and the real access rules. If **fewer than four checks** are reachable, it gives you the **Moonlight Mansion - Area Key** at the start so you have more places to explore.
The key is moved out of the randomized item pool and its place is filled with a filler item, so this does not create a duplicate key or change the pool size. If at least four starting checks are reachable, generation does not automatically grant the key; it remains randomized unless you explicitly included it in your starting inventory.
**Room Sanity checks count toward that threshold.** With Room Sanity off, the corrected Rainbow Route 1-06 chest is no longer a free starting check, so the usual start receives the Moonlight Mansion key. With Room Sanity on, the additional reachable room checks can provide enough checks to keep the key randomized. Room Sanity is not a hard exemption: the same fewer-than-four rule applies to the actual starting state, including custom starting inventory. Disabling Area Keys disables this fallback.
### Downloads and verification files - **`kirbyam.apworld`** is the Archipelago world package to install. - **`kirbyam.provenance.json`** is a build receipt. It records the package's SHA-256 hash, source commit, tag, repository, workflow, and run/attempt so you can check that your download is the exact intended build. - **`kirbyam.attestation.jsonl`** is the signed GitHub build-provenance bundle for the APWorld and its receipt. It lets verification tools check that both files came from this repository's release workflow at the claimed source and tag, rather than trusting an unsigned checksum alone.
The two verification files are attached for integrity, provenance and auditing. They are not extra game content or files you install into Archipelago. Provenance verifies origin and bytes; it does not guarantee the absence of bugs. GitHub's automatically generated source archives are separate from these three release assets. No full ROMs or saves are included.
### Compatibility and details Only the North American ROM is supported. AP notifications are in English. Chests and statues retain their native item/ability appearance. mGBA notifications appear in the visible Archipelago Connector scripting panel, not over the game image.
See the [complete v0.5.0 changelog](https://github.com/hasherwi/Archipelago-kirbyam/blob/744b1a5708ecaafd80313b7836a9197a25f5db0e/worlds/kirbyam/CHANGELOG.md#v050), [save compatibility notes](https://github.com/hasherwi/Archipelago-kirbyam/blob/744b1a5708ecaafd80313b7836a9197a25f5db0e/worlds/kirbyam/dev-docs/rc4-file-selection-rollback.md), and [release verification guide](https://github.com/hasherwi/Archipelago-kirbyam/blob/744b1a5708ecaafd80313b7836a9197a25f5db0e/worlds/kirbyam/docs/release-preparation.md).

# New Presets / Goals!
- **Option presets:** pick Beginner, Full Randomizer, Chaos, Monster Hunter, Speedrun, Stamp Collector or Mog Grooming Only, then tweak anything you like - **Mog Stamps goal:** collect all 23 stamps from the Moogle Nests - **Mog Grooming goal:** dye or trim the Moogle's fur (10–95%) - Grooming tools can be items you have to find (dyes, Mog Soap, Mog Scissors) - Up to 9 new checks: a radar for each dye, plus 25/50/75% dye and trim milestones - **Mog Grooming Only:** a short game with no dungeons, just you and the Moogle
## New options - **Starting Stats:** shuffle the tribes' stats, respread each tribe's points, or roll them fully at random (both genders and every co-op player of a tribe match) - **Starting Hearts:** start with 2 to 8 hearts - **Show Item Messages:** items you send and receive appear at the bottom of the screen (on by default) - **Show Play Timer:** play time, or a speedrun timer that starts at New Game and stops on the final blow (or run it by hand with L + R + Z and the D-pad) - **Show Enemy Health:** a bar, numbers or both - **Extra Spell Rings:** Gravity, Holy, Slow, Stop and Haste - **Free Cure Magicite**, **Gil Weight**, **Lynari Desert North Exit** and a new **Command Slot Trap**

## Chests & client - Chests with another player's item show the **Archipelago logo** (and no more lag opening them) - `/regrow` grows the Moogle's fur back if you trimmed too early - Seed files are now `.apffcc` (old `.ffcc` still works)
## Fixes / Other Updates - Ring of Cure is now its own item, so you can hint it, even with Progressive Artifacts on - Monster Hunt matches kills more reliably and skips enemies that never appear - The "Items Dropped At Your Feet" description is fixed - Updated gender menu in player creation to include "Other" as a option and matched most if not all in game text to match it! entry.title: Mega Man ZX v0.3.0
entry.content:
### Added
- Added the goal `defeat_omega_zero`: beat Omega Zero in N-1. The door of his arena opens with your `goal_requirements` (the rest of Area N is open as always). - Added `zero3_bosses` and `zero4_bosses`: the eight Mega Man Zero 3/4 bosses of N-1 are in the game and each one beaten is a check. They can be named in `boss_logic` - IMPORTANT: each option needs your own Mega Man Zero 3 or Zero 4 (GBA) ROM. The game keeps the sprites of those bosses in the cartridge, so the launcher asks for the ROM when you open the `.apmmzx` and converts them from it. With the option off no ROM is ever asked for. - Added the goal requirement `Mutos Reploid Hunting`: beat `required_mutos_reploids` of those bosses (1 to 8; 5 or more need both games on). - Added the location `Obtain Biometal Z`, sent when you beat Giro in D-2. - Added `area_m_access`: what opens the seal at the entrance of Area M. - `open`: the seal is open from the start, as before. - `biometals`: get the five `Obtain Biometal` checks of your game (Z, H, F, L and P). - `passwords`: collect `required_passwords` Passwords out of the `total_passwords` in the pool. - With `biometals` or `passwords` the Transerver Access of Area M is not in the pool. - Missions can be played again through the new "Replay Missions" option in the Transerver consoles. - While a mission picked there is under way, entering an area does not accept that area's mission. Report or abort the one you picked to go back to normal. - "Abort Mission" is now offered only for a mission picked from the "Replay Missions" list. - Troop Reinforcement replays like any other mission. There's no briefing, head to Area D and play it through. - Added `mission_objectives`: the objects and events of the story missions can be checks, and items too. - `locations_only`: Multiple events and items from the story become checks, like the four Computer Chips in area B, the guardians of Pass The Test or the people trapped in Area G. The game itself plays as before, nothing is changed in progression or how the open world behaves. - `locations_and_items`: the same location, but the objects are also items of the pool. A mission is reported only with its object, Rayfly shows up only with a Computer Chip, the F-3 and G-2 doors open with their own items, and so on. - Added "door constraints": each seed can lock some of the doors between rooms behind a Card Key, so the map opens in smaller steps instead of most of it at once. A locked door shows the colour of its key. - `door_constraints_min` and `door_constraints_max`: how many doors a seed locks (0 to 15, both 0 by default). - Added `include_warps_in_logic`: the teleports to the Guardian Base at the end of Troop Reinforcement and Repel The Army count as a way into Area X, so a check there may expect you to clear one of those missions instead of holding its Transerver Access. Off by default. - The eight "Item A" usables in the game are now items of the pool, and the eight places that hand them out are locations. - Usable items get added to your inventory when you get them as items from the multiworld. Picking them in the game only sends a location. - A usable you have used comes back when you open any Transerver console, so you can use them as much as you want. - The child gives the cake location on any day, even if its not your birthday, once Save The People is completed. - Added `sub_tank_refill_operator`: a Guardian next to your starting Transerver who, for 200 E-Crystals, refills every Sub Tank you hold. - Added `infinite_lives`: when this option is on you lose no lifes and you can't Game Over. With it on, the 1-Up item is not in the filler pool.
### Changed
- The entire logic has been reworked to use AP's Rule Builder. This is mostly internal, but as an upside this means you can now use /get_logical_path or /explain in Universal Tracker. - The filler item pool has been reworked: now there's `25 E-Crystals`, `50 E-Crystals`, `100 E-Crystals`, `Energy Refill`, `Weapon Energy Refill` and `1-Up`. The goal is to lower the total ammount of useless E-Crystals, as well as making filler feel at least slightly relevant. - Some client messages have been modified so they only show in debug , as they are not relevant for the player usually.
### Fixed
- Small logic fixes and adjustments - The following missions had their "cleared mission" flag removed by other events sometimes. This should be fixed now. - Stop The Dig stopped counting as completed after reporting Repel The Army. - Find The Survivors stopped counting as completed after reporting Recover The Disk - Fight The Mavericks after reporting Attack The Excavators

- ### **Card abilities can now be split across missions!** - Abilities can be set to either: - unlock **per in-game mission** (e.g. Rebirth - Elevate (Fire) to get it for every level that is in Rebirth in the base game), which is **currently the new default**, - unlock per **generated mission** (e.g. Mission 1 - Elevate (Fire) to get it for every level in your *own* Mission 1), - or keep them **global** (e.g. one Elevate (Fire) for the whole game). - You can also set certain cards to be **forced to be global** on the mission settings (e.g. it defaults to Katana and the Book of Life being 1 item each for the whole game.) - Additionally, some cards are now marked as *Useful* instead of *Progression* when they aren't logically relevant, and only cards that appear in those missions will appear in the item pool at all. - Level Randomization has been tweaked to make for better progression! - Levels now properly take into account all the items you would have to clear every check in that level, and influences other levels that are similar to it to be closer to it. - The **Level Selection Variance** setting acts very similar still, with 0% meaning it will guarantee levels in a linear order, and 100% being very random. The **default for this setting was changed** to *30%* down from *50%*. - The **Starting Level Count** setting has been changed to go off of total check counts for your starting items. - Previously, it only added starting levels that were guaranteed to be completable to your max medal, and would not select any levels that don't have gifts. - This change was made to prevent restrictive starts even harder, and should make the start of the world more open. Thus, the **default for this setting was changed** to *3* down from *5*. Most settings couldn't reach 5 starting levels that fit in the criteria anyway. - New filler items have been introduced to help any potential filler feel less repetitive. - Added items: Garbage, Book of Death Page, Cloud 9 Minigolf Ball, Neon Mask, Secret of Heaven. - All of these are referenced in voiced dialogue! - (Hopefully with all of these changes, you won't be seeing that much of these anyway!)
## APWorld-Only Changes - **Universal Tracker is now** (actually) **fully supported!** (and I actually tested it this time) - This includes **yaml-less, glitched logic, custom location sorting that fits your mission order, and shiny new `/explain` for relevant checks!** - There are now **option groups** that helps keep the options in the launcher's options creator nice and categorized/sorted! - An absurd amount of internal restructuring that makes for both less fill errors and faster fill! - Neon Ranks outside of the % required are classified as Useful for item filling. They're turned back to Progression in post fill (keeps UT in check and makes spoiler log generate faster). - A custom rule builder rule class has been made to check rules faster than before, including its own caching system which especially helps for worlds with multiple Neon Whites. - There is now a custom fill hook that places items inside the progression item pool in a way that speeds up gen and helps the generator get less stuck. - Fuzzer meta files have been added to the repo for checking progress against the fuzzer tool: - [`fuzzer_default`](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/fuzzer_default.yaml) checks against most of the default settings. (**100%!**) - [`fuzzer_player`](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/fuzzer_player.yaml) checks settings that are within reasonable ranges and probabilities for most people who play this APWorld. (**~100%!**) - [`fuzzer_all`](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/fuzzer_all.yaml) just ensures the goal condition is set to `3bosses` to help limit the amount of ignored results. (roughly **98%** success rate!) - Various other changes were made to ensure we pass all unit tests! - (except for the memory leak test: there are no problems when actually generating (including no-output), but specifically the test doesn't appear to like it.)

entry.title: Castlevania - Aria of Sorrow v2026.11.1
entry.content:
- **New option: Progressive Movement.** Three Progressive Movement items replace Flying Armor, Malphas and Giant Bat, and always give them in that order. Your own copies show up as Skull Keys and need the client connected to grant their soul. - **Universal Tracker support.** UT now rebuilds your seed's logic from the server, with no YAML needed, including your logic difficulty and Hard Mode settings. Seeds generated before this release only give it their goal and Hard Mode setting, so it uses the defaults for their other logic options. UT also gets a map tab for the whole castle, the Chaotic Realm and each area, with a pin for every location colored by logic. It marks where Soma is and follows him from area to area, and nothing extra needs installing. Locations that only an out-of-logic trick reaches show in UT's color for reachable with tricks. - **New browser map tracker.** Type `/map` in the BizHawk Client or the Collection Client, or press their "Open map" button, to open a map of the castle in your browser. The Launcher also offers it as "Aria of Sorrow Tracker", including from a room page's link. It shows each location's logic status and where Soma is. By default it shows only the parts of the castle you have explored, which the Castle Maps reveal by area, and a toggle shows everything. Find Route draws the way from Soma's room to the location you select, except in race rooms. It runs on your own machine and needs nothing else installed. - **New option: Hard Mode Pickups.** The five Hard Mode-only pickups can be shuffled with Hard Mode (the default), always (they then spawn in normal mode too), or never. - **Giant Bat stays late.** With item smoothing on, the early mobility soul is now Malphas or Hippogryph, never Giant Bat. - **The Ancient Books explain themselves.** With Ancient Book Soul Drops on, Books 1 and 3 now say in the pause menu that their soul always drops. Book 2 has no drop effect, because the Giant Bat soul is a multiworld item, and the option text now says so. - **Clearer Advance Collection messages.** If the collection is running the Japanese or European Aria of Sorrow, Circle of the Moon or Harmony of Dissonance, the client now says which one and asks for the US Aria of Sorrow. - **Advance Collection installer:** it now asks where game.exe is if your Steam library isn't on the default path. If an install fails partway, it puts the collection's stock files back, and tells you if it couldn't. It now installs any seed, including ones generated for BizHawk, and the Launcher has a **CVAoS Collection Restore** button that puts the stock game back.
- **Renamed option:** "Library-to-Forbidden-Area Button Handling (Study Sealswitch)" is now **Forbidden Area Button**. Existing YAMLs still work, because the setting's name in the YAML (`forbidden_area_button`) is unchanged.
**Fixes** - Ability souls you receive (Malphas, Hippogryph, Galamoth and the rest) now arrive switched on. Before, they arrived switched off in the Ability menu and did nothing until you turned them on. - With Oops! All Whips on, logic no longer expects a weapon to break floors or ceilings, since every weapon swings like the Whip Sword. It waits for Black Panther instead. - With the Study Sealswitch shuffled, logic no longer expects you to climb from the Forbidden Area up to the Study without it. - Logic no longer counts on farming the Manticore that guards its room only once. - Seeds with the Study Sealswitch shuffled have a Lucky Charm again. The Sealswitch now takes the place of a 100 Gold pickup. - The room where the Forbidden Area button was no longer shows Castle Corridor's particle effects. - A DeathLink that arrives while Sky Fish is active now plays Soma's death animation. - A received item's "Got" box no longer replaces the box for something you picked up at the same moment. - Received weapons, armor and accessories now play the equipment pickup sound. - On a save made with the game's Copy option, received souls now count the ones you already had. Received gold now stops at the game's cap of 999,999. - The Collection Client now sends your checks again after it reconnects. - Starting inventory is now actually given to you in game, in seeds generated with this version. - Seeds already in progress keep working after you update. Their starting inventory still isn't given in game. - Item smoothing no longer puts progression in locations you excluded, takes it out of priority locations, or moves plando'd Ancient Books. - Seeds with many priority locations (about 25 or more) no longer fail to generate when item smoothing is on. - With Soul Shuffle and Keep Soul Drop Rates on, a Headhunter, Death, Legion or Balore soul that landed on an ordinary enemy could never drop. It now drops at that enemy's usual rate. - DeathLink deaths no longer pile up: one that arrives while Soma is already dead is dropped, and several during a pause kill him once. - Reconnecting while Soma is dying no longer sends his death to everyone a second time. - Moving on to a seed without DeathLink no longer leaves DeathLink switched on in the client. - A received item is no longer given twice when BizHawk pauses or the connection drops at the wrong moment. - Installing a different seed into the collection while the client is open now reconnects you as the new seed's slot. - The BizHawk client no longer stops working when a request times out, for example while BizHawk is paused. - Patching now checks that the base ROM is the original US ROM and says so if it isn't. - When the generator needs extra filler, it now makes only plain filler, never a soul or a Hard Mode item. - The Randomize Pickups option, which did nothing, is no longer shown.
**Installing** - Put `cvaos.apworld` in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder, replacing any older copy. It needs Archipelago 0.6.6 or newer. - Seeds from 2026.09.04 and 2026.10.30 still play with this version, so you can update partway through one. Seeds generated with this version need this version's clients, and older clients refuse them.

entry.title: Castlevania - Aria of Sorrow v2026.11.7
entry.content:
- **New Experimental options.** A collapsed "Experimental" group on the options page holds four new options and a new Soul Shuffle value. Their balance is measured but not play-tested, so they may change between versions. Each one is opt-in and off by default, so released YAMLs keep working and play as before. A Soul Shuffle of "random" still never picks the new value. The options page's "Experimental" preset turns all five on, at the settings they were measured with. - **Experimental: Enemy Checks.** The first defeat of each boss ("bosses", 10 checks) or of each kind of enemy ("all", 112 checks) is a check. The client reads defeats from the game's Enemy List, so one made while it is disconnected is sent when it reconnects. Each check adds one item from this game to the pool, and it is never progression. Iron Golem's and Final Guard's checks hold only filler for now. With "all" and the default hint cost, a hint costs 22 checks instead of 11. - **Enemy checks in hints, groups and trackers.** A hint for an enemy check names the rooms where that enemy appears. Location groups such as "Boss Defeats", "Unrouted Enemy Defeats" and "Chapel Defeats" let you exclude or prioritize enemy checks together. Both map trackers pin each check in every room where its enemy appears. - **Most enemy checks come late in logic.** The routes to most rooms' enemies aren't recorded yet, so logic expects all eight movement souls before those checks. You will usually make them much earlier, so once one of an enemy's rooms is reachable, the trackers show its check in their color for reachable with tricks. A boss's check needs only a way into its arena. - **Experimental: Soul Shuffle "matched".** Each soul trades places only with a soul of the same color and strength tier, rated from community tier lists. Each enemy keeps its own soul drop rate, so a run gives about as many souls of each color and tier as an unshuffled one. - **Experimental: Enemy Drop Rate.** Enemies drop their soul and their common item more often, from 100% (no change) up to 1000%. Enemies your seed reaches early get only a small part of the boost, while strong souls you could find early, rare drops and the better items keep their usual chance. Above 100, it replaces Multiply Soul Drop Rates. - **Experimental: Item Drop Shuffle.** The items that enemies drop move into the item pool, so any player's location can hold them. An enemy whose drop moved drops a similar item from this game instead. The drops are then dealt out again, so early enemies drop cheap items and the castle's last enemies drop the best ones. - **Experimental: Wide Item Smoothing.** Weapons and armor that are too good for the start of a run stay out of it, whether they come from a pickup, an enemy check, another world or an enemy drop. It also makes sure you hold an early weapon and armor, and it sets Item Smoothing to strict and Item Smoothing Order to spheres. In a multiworld it runs Archipelago's progression balancing itself, which a host can turn off with `wide_smoothing_runs_balancing` in host.yaml. - **New client commands: /souls and /drops.** In both clients, `/souls` lists which enemy drops each soul and how often, and `/drops` lists the items each enemy drops. They read the ROM you are playing, so they work for any seed. - **Drop tables in the spoiler.** When a seed changes which enemy drops which soul or item, or how often, the spoiler now lists every enemy's drops and their chances. - **Received gold gets its banner.** Gold you receive now shows the game's "$100"-style box and plays the gold sound, as a gold pickup does. - **Items have one name.** Every copy of an item now shares its plain name, so every Potion is "Potion" and a hint for "Potion" can find any of them. Location names still tell the pickups apart, and seeds from earlier versions still grant and track the same items. A YAML that names a numbered copy, such as "Potion (A)", still works in local and non-local items, start hints, item links' item pools and plando lists, where the old name now stands for every copy. In `start_inventory` and an item link's replacement item, use the plain name instead. - **Local play-data log.** The client now writes a log of each run to the `cvaos_play_data` folder inside your Archipelago `logs` folder. It records the souls you own, your checks, your equipped weapon and armor, and the drops your Enemy List shows. Nothing in it is sent to the server or to other players. - **Saves from another seed send no checks.** If you load a save that has received more items than the server has sent for this seed, such as one from another seed or a New Game+ started from one, the client holds back its checks and goal and prints a warning. It carries on once you load this seed's save. If the server lost its most recent checks in a crash, your own save can trip this too; type `/trust_save` to send its checks. - **New seeds need this version.** Seeds generated with this version need this apworld to apply their patch and this version's clients to play. An older apworld stops with "Unknown procedure", and an older client refuses the ROM. Seeds from the 2026.09.04, 2026.10.30 and 2026.11.01 releases still play with this version, so you can update partway through one. - **Patches that need a newer apworld say so.** From this version on, applying a patch that holds a feature this apworld doesn't know fails with a message naming the version the seed needs, instead of building a ROM without that feature. - **Cheaper filler.** When Archipelago needs extra filler for this game, as item links do, it now makes only cheap consumables and gold. Before, a linked player could get Gungner, Samurai Armor or other mid-game gear at the very start. It also stops adding a consumable you already have 9 of in your pool, the most the game lets you carry, and adds gold instead.
**Fixes** - Soma can now pick up a Skull Key while he holds 9. Before, a player who reached 9 Skull Keys while the client was disconnected could no longer collect other players' items. - When the Collection Client or the installer meets a seed it can't use, the message now names every patch format it accepts, rather than only the newest. - For contributors: the routing tool now builds the same graph as generation, a transdoor override that would change nothing fails at load, and an unusable custom pickup icon raises an error that names the problem instead of exiting.
**Installing** - Put `cvaos.apworld` in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder, replacing any older copy. It needs Archipelago 0.6.6 or newer. - Seeds from 2026.09.04, 2026.10.30 and 2026.11.01 still play with this version, so you can update partway through one. Seeds generated with this version need this version's apworld and clients.

Your 0.2.4 install isn't touched. - Use the alpha3 client and APWorld together. Alpha2 rooms still connect fine. - Your alpha2 YAML still works. The seven new traps are on at their default weights, so set them to 0 in `trap_weights` if you don't want them. `ctr_first` is now `trophy_ctr_combined` (the old name still works). - Got a YAML from someone else? If it says `version: 0.6.8` and you generate on 0.6.7 (Play Solo does), it won't load. Change the number to your version. ## Fixed since alpha2 - Fixed the freezes with big custom track libraries in the menus, Play Solo and at race start. Fixed. - Aku Aku hints in hub door corridors could smear the mask or crash the game. Fixed. - Bosses on N. Gin Labs could gain a lap on the barrel ramp. Fixed. - Boss cups follow One-Lap Cup Races now. - Seeds with all 27 pads as cups generate again. - The Purple Gem Cup boss gauntlet doesn't ask for all five Gem Cups anymore. - Saphi downloads wait when the site is busy instead of failing. - Custom tracks: no more duplicates in Play Solo after a re-import, This Seed always shows your seed, and the Library tells you when the Saphi catalogue failed to load. - Boss races on custom tracks don't show the retail track's boxes anymore. - No more AP boxes on the unreachable crate on Ancient Lake and North Pole. ## New - Seven new traps: Always Jumping, No Drifting, Rival Surge, Mud Season, Limp Mode, Stuck Steering and Wumpa Leak. Button hints match your Xbox or Steam Deck controller (you can turn that off in Options). - Play Solo opens imported YAMLs with all their options, and has a page to set each trap's weight. - The importer knows more track names and supports a few more tracks, including three from Coco Team Racing. - New defaults: both pad hint filters are on, and Crystal Challenges can use all seven arenas. - Experimental and off by default: recorded AI laps. Up to three racers drive laps from the files in your `ap-navpaths` folder. ## Known issues - North Pole can have broken trees when it's the third race of a cup. - The screen froze once in a custom track race when a release sent a ton of items at once. Restarting the client fixed it. I'm looking into it. - Some menu text is hard to read where it runs over the logo. - The Saphi catalogue might still not show up for some people. entry.title: Harry Potter 2 PC v3.0.0.post4
entry.content:
# HP2PC_AP v3.0.0
The randomizer now runs on the original PC release of the game with SafeDiscShim, instead of the separate install that v2.12.0 and earlier needed. Everyone needs to set up again: follow the attached `PLAYER_SETUP.md`.
### Upgrading from v2.12.0 or earlier
- **Clean your host.yaml first.** Delete the whole `harry_potter_2_pc_options` block from `host.yaml` in your Archipelago folder before you start the new client. The old block points at the old install, and the client would carry that path over. With the block gone, the client asks for your new install on the first connect and writes fresh settings. - **Replace the apworld.** Swap the old `harry_potter_2_pc.apworld` in `custom_worlds` for this one. - **Start new seeds and saves.** Seeds and saves from the old setup do not carry over. You can leave the old install alone or remove it.
### New
- **Plays on the original game.** Install the game and add SafeDiscShim (free, open source), which lets the game's copy protection run on Windows 10 and 11. No game files ship with this project. - **One install for both game modes.** Vanilla and open castle seeds play on the same install. The client tells the mod which mode the seed uses. - **Borderless window.** The game opens at your monitor's size without a window frame. - **60 fps cap.** The game is held at the speed its physics and timers are tuned for. - **Widescreen view.** The view widens on wide screens, and the menus draw in a centered 4:3 area with black bars at the sides. - **Non-English installs.** The dialogue randomizer works on the game's own language. - **Linux (experimental).** The client finds the game's Wine or Proton prefix and launches the game through Wine. Nobody has confirmed the disc check under Wine yet.
All three display settings are on by default and can be turned off in `host.yaml`.
### Changed
- **Quieter client window.** On connect, the client only says when the mod was updated. Routine details go to the log file. - **Player names with accents** show with the nearest plain letters, since the game cannot draw them. - **Ghost players** wear a pair of grey-blue glasses that stays visible on their see-through face. - **Open castle seeds with nothing to do at the start** are rejected at generation with a hint (add starting spells or turn on secrets), instead of failing to fill.
### Fixed
- **See-through textures** (torch cages, fences, Harry's glasses) no longer draw solid, also after Alt+Tab. - **Trader menus** take clicks again on wide screens. - **Ghost players** carry their wand again. - **A force-closed game** no longer comes back fullscreen at 640x480 on the next launch. - **First start of the game** no longer crashes with `BeginScene failed (DDERR_SURFACELOST)`. The setup guide has you switch the game to windowed before you start it for the first time. - **Freestanding cards** (the Grand Staircase card, the Castle Exterior ledge cards and others) no longer vanish after your first visit to their area. Saves where one already went missing get it back on the next visit. - **Traps and items for other worlds** show their Archipelago logo again instead of being invisible. - **Chests and containers** open again on your next visit when you left their item lying uncollected, so an item that bounced out of reach is never lost. The Entry Hall wooden chest no longer turns into an unopenable box after leaving and returning. - **Cauldron items** drop next to the cauldron instead of landing somewhere out of reach. - **Cards bought from a vendor** stay where they dropped until you pick them up.
